messages:
elaine.p: noticed spike in "unknown-route" bucket on the console this morning, ~03:15 UTC, only on prod canaries
rufus.ingest: saw same. ingestion logs show route header as "X-Route-Intent" sometimes, and "x-route-intent" other times. aggregation is case-sensitive atm
michael.go: that aligns with the Go client change we shipped yesterday (go-client v0.9.1). we switched to canonicalizing headers to Title-Case for proxy compatibility, must have an edge-case
tara.devex: customers on dedicated who pin routes are getting charged against fallback bucket because console didn't map the Title-Case variant to the canonical key
deploy-bot: deploy 8123 started for go-client v0.9.1 :rocket:
elaine.p: can we get a quick list of affected tenants? rufus, can the ingestion team flag/by-tenant query?
rufus.ingest: pulling list now, returning tenants with >1000 hits in unknown-route in past hour
--- rufus.ingest: results pasted ---
- tenant-omega (1203 hits)
- tenant-gamma (340 hits)
- tenant-canary-3 (91 hits)

michael.go: Repro: curl shows header casing change on net/http client unless we preserve original header key. Example:
```
curl -i -H "x-route-intent: rerank" -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# server sees: X-Route-Intent: rerank
```
tara.devex: ux/console ask: should console normalize headers case-insensitively? that would avoid future client oops but might mask buggy clients
elaine.p: short-term, we need a defense in console ingestion to map known headers case-insensitively for aggregation. long-term, SDKs should stop altering casing and should dedupe/normalize route keys before send
michael.go: i'll cut a patch to the go client to preserve incoming header case when building the request and add a unit test. opening WIP: https://github.com/redwoodinc/go-client/pull/512
deploy-bot: PR checks running (512) :building:
tara.devex: please also add an e2e telemetry smoke to the SDK release job that sends one request to staging console and validates aggregation buckets
elaine.p: and we need an ingestion backfill script to reassign the unknown-route counts for tenants listed. rufus, can you estimate runtime and risk?
rufus.ingest: backfill should be safe; risk is double-apply. i'll make idempotent transform and run in dry-mode first. estimate 20-30m for the three tenants
michael.go: CI failed on lint for header-preserve test :x: fixing now
--- 15m later ---
michael.go: pushed fix and test, CI green. will cut 0.9.2-hotfix and request expedited canary roll (5%)
tara.devex: rollout plan sounds good: 1) ingestion case-insensitive mapping in parallel (dry-run) 2) go client hotfix canary 5% 3) if green -> 20% 4) run backfill for affected tenants 5) promote to all
elaine.p: support message drafted for customers. short explanation + reassurance + console banner draft attached in thread (internal link)
rufus.ingest: turning on dry-run mapping now, will report anomalies in 30m
michael.go: will open matching patches for python/ts to ensure we don't repeat this, linking PRs once made
tara.devex: action items: michael -> go hotfix PR and release note; rufus -> backfill dry-run & mapping; elaine -> support banner; devex -> add e2e telemetry smoke to release job
elaine.p: thanks all, follow up sync in 2h to confirm backfill and metrics
